decisions.decision: The Board asked the Land Use Director to provide a list of possible properties with stop signs that could be made legal.
decisions.quote: the board asked that the land use director provide a list of possible properties that have stop signs that could be made legal.

decisions.decision: The Board requested the Police Chief work with the Land Use Director to incorporate stop signs on private developments into the review process (regulations, by-law, etc.).
decisions.quote: the board requested the chief work with the land use director to incorporate stop signs on private developments into the review process

decisions.decision: The Chief is to locate places in the Rules and Orders where a street sign or no parking sign is called for but none exists; the Board asked that all roads that should have no parking be included.
decisions.quote: the board asked that all roads that should have no parking be included.

decisions.decision: The Police Chief will include the Fire Chief in reviewing places where no parking signs should be.
decisions.quote: the police chief will include the fire chief in reviewing places where no parking signs should be.

decisions.decision: Selectman Ebersole offered to work with Chief Marino on a map of roads where no parking is currently allowed, including road width.
decisions.quote: selectman ebersole offered to work with chief marino on creating a map with roads that there currently is no parking allowed, including the width of the road.

decisions.decision: The Board's scheduled site visit to the no parking areas will wait until a map is produced.
decisions.quote: the board's scheduled site visit to the no parking areas will wait until a map is produced.

decisions.decision: All agreed that a chart of fines to reference would make the Traffic Rules and Orders easier for users.
decisions.quote: all agreed that a chart to reference would make it easier for users.
